data.text: Thanks for lunch, Luke, but I’m with Emma: I’ll take 10 tons. Your plan gives the four of us an extra $5,000 now, but the smaller harvest next month cancels that gain for the group—and leaves you unpaid this month. I’d rather we all earn steadily and keep the lake full. My family taught me to leave enough for the next catch; our village relies on that. Can we agree to 10 tons each this month and review everyone’s catches together afterward? John, are you on board?
